commands: if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then echo "$script is missing; leaving Foundry and the host running" >&2; exit 1; fi
bash "$script" || echo "$script exited $?; checking Foundry anyway" >&2
for i in $(seq 1 90); do pgrep -f /foundry/foundryvtt/main.js >/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done
if pgrep -f /foundry/foundryvtt/main.js >/dev/null; then echo 'Foundry is still running; leaving the host running' >&2; pgrep -af /foundry/foundryvtt/main.js >&2; exit 1; fi
